digest.component_or_area: CI/CD testing infrastructure, pytest suite performance analysis
propositions: An exhaustive audit of all CI test phases ≥1.0 second across three representative Gerrit Verify runs and a local exhaustive macOS pass identifies 501 unique phases with durations and platform variance.

Gerrit 1817 landed a proven macOS-to-Ubuntu routing that removes 19 OS/Python-invariant repository-policy nodes from macOS while retaining them in Ubuntu 3.13, projecting ~8s macOS critical-path savings and ~24.84 aggregate runner-seconds without increasing job count.

No individual pytest setup/call/teardown phase exceeded 30 seconds in recent successful CI runs; the top-25 durations provide only 14-16% of observed default wall time, and CI log truncation limits comprehensive phase discovery below rank 25.

Real external behavior (Git locks, partial clone, process/filesystem/socket semantics, binary discovery, signing, concurrency) remains intentional and preserved; no faster mock oracle has been proven equivalent for these seams.

Test-owned deployment/observability/reviewer-bot window durations are reducible via bounded test triggers and injected scheduling (approved direction: songful-groovelike-horsemouse), while production boundaries and real process cleanup remain intact.
